subject: vt-u-pt
title: VT.U.PT.------C.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 107 ((AF)D-35). VT-U-PT (vibrational universe particulars) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From PROJ-DY: HI-P (high purpose). From MT-INFO: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From WO-EXP-PRI: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From IF-ST-DY: MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). From COS-P: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From MTA-RT-SIGN: PRI-INFO (principle information).
